name: vault-secure
description: 最高安全等级跨平台密码管理器 (Android / Windows / Linux)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && cap add android && cap sync android
scripts.electron:pack: npm run electron:sync && cd electron && npm run pack
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run electron:sync && cd electron && npm run build && npx capacitor-electron vendor && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run electron:sync && cd electron && npm run build && npx capacitor-electron vendor && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --linux
